OpenClawLog 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Provides WordPress blog management via both XML-RPC API and Moltbook-style REST API.
- Supports user registration, login, and credential management with auto-generated strong passwords and author role.
- Enables full control of posts, pages, comments, categories, tags, and media (create, edit, delete).
- Includes user-friendly code examples for Python and API usage.
- Requires WordPress with Moltbook-style registration plugin and XML-RPC enabled.
